dependency_audit.scope: macOS ARM64 logical installed distribution files, excluding bytecode; marginal closure above common configured runtime including onnx; no installed packages removed

limitations: macOS ARM64 only; other host execution pending
Memory is isolated process RSS including Python and necessary input; excludes embedding/reranking and is not whole production server RSS
Build peak captured before full verification snapshots; numpy mmap input and metadata batches included
Visible disk sampling is a lower bound; misses unlinked/out-of-tree SQLite VACUUM files and sub-10ms peaks
Build final_store_bytes precedes connection close and may retain WAL; steady_store_bytes follows lifecycle reopen
SQLite VACUUM may need twice database size in additional free space: https://www.sqlite.org/lang_vacuum.html
Dependency savings require remaining Lance consumers migrated and older destinations no longer needing shared packages
Common libraries/model caches remain; prepared benchmark input does not establish production migration staging needs
